summary.associated_batch_semantics: Deduplicated complete batches containing a parked node ID and overlapping pool presence before the following service observation. Bytes and time include other nodes/pools and are not attributed to the parked agent, proof of component reuse, wasted traffic, or removable JCT.

tool_prediction_timing.reason: This audit uses server wall clocks for recovery associations. It does not convert client monotonic tool boundaries into wall time; no tool timing precision is inferred.
